criteria.name: Specifications
criteria.feedback: Your submission always returns a valid palindrome and handles some edge cases, but does not consistently find the numerically closest palindrome as required; reviewing your method for comparing candidates will improve your results.

criteria.name: Efficiency
criteria.feedback: Your solution efficiently constructs palindromes in O(n) time and avoids brute-force methods, but the center adjustment does not always yield the closest palindrome or account for all hexadecimal edge cases, so there is room for further optimization.

criteria.name: Modularity
criteria.feedback: Your code shows an effort toward modularity, with a dedicated helper and well-isolated testing code, but much of the palindrome logic is still grouped in one large function; consider refactoring checking, construction, and tie handling into separate functions for improved clarity and reusability.

criteria.name: Code Clarity
criteria.feedback: Your code uses clear and descriptive names, and logic is easy to follow overall, but minor issues like the misspelled 'adjascent_digit' and some sections (such as the negative-index palindrome logic) could be clarified with brief comments for full marks. Consider correcting minor naming errors and adding short comments to unintuitive sections to further improve readability.
